title: 019 · Why? #7: area between y = x and y = x³ is ¼, strips + ½ − ¼ (NDA 2022 (I) Q78; predict-first, white)

captions.instagram:
NDA Maths · Area under curves. The area between y = x and y = x³ from 0 to 1 is…? A ½ · B ¼ · C ⅛ 👇

B. Between 0 and 1 the line is on top, so every strip is top minus bottom: (x − x³).
Add the strips: ∫₀¹ (x − x³) dx = ½ − ¼ = ¼.
Or in pictures: ½ under the line, take away the ¼ under x³.
Traps: ½ forgets to subtract; ⅛ multiplies instead.

This is NDA 2022 (I), Q78, word for word.
